generate_fake_structures: generate fake atomic structures with LJ-like energies and repulsive forces using a FakeDatasetConfig
create_fake_dataset: create a single fake ASE database from a FakeDatasetConfig and write it to disk
create_fake_benchmark_dataset: generate all 5 UMA benchmark datasets with production-like system sizes in a temp directory
compute_lj_energy: compute the Lennard-Jones potential energy for an ASE Atoms object with configurable epsilon and sigma
calculate_repulsive_forces: calculate pairwise repulsive forces between atoms in an ASE Atoms object using inverse-square scaling
